trigger.material_observation: Playwright integral exposed protected full-reload navigations that transiently redirected through /login and then /dashboard even though tenant-context and permission HTTP calls later returned 200. The failure trace showed Modelos:Ver present for the administrator, excluding an intended RBAC denial.

root_cause: permisoGuard could evaluate while the verified tenant context was still being rehydrated asynchronously by authGuard after a full reload. PermisosRuntimeService.cargar() treats a missing in-memory verified tenant as false, so the permission guard could emit a fail-closed redirect before tenant revalidation completed; the authenticated login route then redirected to dashboard and lost the originally requested protected route.

direct_fix.behavior: permission evaluation now independently revalidates the persisted tenant request server-side when verified context is not yet in memory, then loads permissions; missing tenant or any revalidation failure remains fail-closed to /login
security_invariants: tenant membership is revalidated server-side before permission evaluation
no permission or gate was bypassed
